Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Title ==

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ゴミ圧縮装置の上にいるすべてのものは潰される（ロストする）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-278o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ゴミ圧縮装置はゴミを潰して宇宙に放り出す。ゴミの漏出を防ぐため、磁気で密閉されている。Ｒ２－Ｄ２は圧縮装置３２６３８２７の動力を遮断して同胞の命を救った。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Card text:''' Everything in the Trash Compactor is crushed and lost.

'''Lore:''' Trash compactors crush refuse and eject it into space. A magnetic seal prevents leaks. R2-D2 saved his companions by cutting power to compactor 3263827.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 6
* '''Printed subtype:''' Lost Interrupt
